title: Visitor calls Strieber 'the luckiest of the lucky'

tellings.quote: one of the visitors when I was in the abduction experience said to me, "You're the luckiest of the lucky."

plain: In the 1980s, during what he calls an abduction experience, the writer Whitley Strieber says one of the beings he calls "the visitors" told him, "You're the luckiest of the lucky." Strieber tells this as his own experience, and he presents his contact with these beings as a gift rather than a curse.
